from collections import Counter,defaultdict
# reuse parser by importing? Simpler parse output top directed pairs? Better recompute from saved assign maybe repeat concise
import subprocess, sys, os

with open('results/windows35_to_gencode.paf') as f:

        fields=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        q=fields[0]; strand=fields[4]; t=fields[5]
        matches=int(fields[9]); blen=int(fields[10]); qs=int(fields[2]); qe=int(fields[3])
        if blen<28 or matches<28 or matches/blen<0.90: continue
        gene=t.split('|')[5]
        hits[q].append((matches, qe-qs, gene, strand))
assign={}
for q,hs in hits.items():
    best=max((h[0],h[1]) for h in hs)
    top=[h for h in hs if (h[0],h[1])==best]
    genes={h[2] for h in top}; strands={h[3] for h in top}
    if len(genes)==1 and len(strands)==1:
        assign[q]=(next(iter(genes)), next(iter(strands)))
byread=defaultdict(dict)
for q,(g,s) in assign.items():
    rid,pos=q.rsplit('|',1); byread[rid][int(pos)]=(g,s)
pair=Counter(); support=defaultdict(set)
for rid,d in byread.items():
    blocks=[]
    for pos,(g,s) in sorted(d.items()):
        if not blocks or blocks[-1][1]"'!=g or blocks[-1][2]!=s:
            blocks.append((pos,g,s))
    seen=set()
    for a,b in zip(blocks,blocks[1:]):
        _,g1,s1=a; _,g2,s2=b
        if g1==g2 or s1!=s2: continue
        p=(g1,g2) if s1=='"'+' else (g2,g1)
        seen.add(p)
    for p in seen:
        pair[p]+=1; support[p].add(rid)

for (a,b),c in sorted(pair.items(), key=lambda kv:(kv[1]-pair.get((kv[0][1],kv[0][0]),0),kv[1]), reverse=True)[:200]:

import sys
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
paf=sys.argv[1]; minmatch=int(sys.argv[2]); minblen=int(sys.argv[3]); outprefix=sys.argv[4]
hits=defaultdict(list)
with open(paf) as f:
    for line in f:
        fields=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        q=fields[0]; strand=fields[4]; t=fields[5]
        matches=int(fields[9]); blen=int(fields[10]); qs=int(fields[2]); qe=int(fields[3])
        if blen<minblen or matches<minmatch or matches/blen<0.92: continue
        gene=t.split('|')[5]
        hits[q].append((matches, qe-qs, gene, strand))
assign={}
for q,hs in hits.items():
    best=max((h[0],h[1]) for h in hs)
    top=[h for h in hs if (h[0],h[1])==best]
    genes={h[2] for h in top}; strands={h[3] for h in top}
    if len(genes)==1 and len(strands)==1:
        assign[q]=(next(iter(genes)), next(iter(strands)))
byread=defaultdict(dict)
for q,(g,s) in assign.items():
    rid,pos=q.rsplit('|',1); byread[rid][int(pos)]=(g,s)
pair=Counter()
for rid,d in byread.items():
    blocks=[]
    for pos,(g,s) in sorted(d.items()):
        if not blocks or blocks[-1][1]"'!=g or blocks[-1][2]!=s:
            blocks.append((pos,g,s))
    seen=set()
    for a,b in zip(blocks,blocks[1:]):
        _,g1,s1=a; _,g2,s2=b
        if g1==g2 or s1!=s2: continue
        p=(g1,g2) if s1=='"'+' else (g2,g1)
        seen.add(p)
    for p in seen: pair[p]+=1
print('assigned',len(assign),'reads',len(byread),'pairs',len(pair))
print('candidate genes')
for gene in ['MYC','SP1','CATSPER4','ZIC2']:
    print('---',gene)
    rows=[(c,a,b,pair.get((b,a),0)) for (a,b),c in pair.items() if a==gene or b==gene]
    for c,a,b,r in sorted(rows, reverse=True)[:50]: print(c,r,a,b)
print('zero reverse >=5')
for (a,b),c in sorted(pair.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1], reverse=True):
    if c>=5 and pair.get((b,a),0)==0:
        print(c,a,b)
